features: Direct score/logit; separate native marginal and interpreter conditional probabilities, labels, direct-score interactions; same-class products of native and interpreter probabilities. Products express agreement, not joint probabilities.
selection: Five connected development folds, four ridge penalties 0.1/1/10/100, equal mass per language-local formal/conversational class. Recall-gap threshold targets unchanged 99% recall; select gate eligibility then worst/total false-review rate and stronger regularization.
audit: Freeze fit before calibration; reused synthetic calibration is regression evidence. Any interpreter abstention remains an error. No text, case ID or group label as predictive feature.
limitations: Base models already used development and calibration informed prior repair designs; this is not independent model validation.
